content.title: Will There Be an 'XO, Kitty' Season 4? Here's What We Know About the Netflix Charmer's Future
content.text: Key PointsNetflix hasn’t confirmed XO, Kitty season 4, but renewal news is expected soon.Key cast members, including Anna Cathcart, are likely to return if season 4 proceeds.Season 4 could explore Kitty’s last semester at KISS and her future with Min Ho. Yes, we’re being greedy — the third season of XO, Kitty only just premiered on Netflix on Thursday, April 2, and we already have our sights on even more adventures abroad with Kitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart) and co. in a fourth season. In case you haven’t tuned in yet, XO, Kitty is the spinoff series of Netflix’s beloved To All The Boy I’ve Loved Before film franchise; we initially met the titular Covey daughter when she was simply the meddling little sis of those movies’ main character, Lara Jean Covey (Lana Condor). In this sequel series, however, a now-teenaged Kitty is our romantic lead, as we follow her journey studying abroad at K.I.S.S. (Korean Independent School of Seoul) and doing some kissing of her own with frenemy-turned-crush Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee). And given everything that went down between Kitty and Min Ho in season three (no spoilers here, don’t worry!), we’d be shocked if Netflix doesn’t move forward with a fourth edition of the fan-favorite series. Here’s everything we know so far about XO, Kitty season 4. 🎬SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Netflix hasn’t yet announced whether or not XO, Kitty will continue for a fourth season. However, if the coming-of-age charmer does get greenlit for a season 4, the news should be coming in a few weeks’ time, using previous seasons as precedent: After season one premiered in May 2023, the series was renewed for a second season in June. Similarly, after XO, Kitty season 2 debuted in January 2025, the streamer snatched it up with a season-three renewal in February. Given that the third season only just hit the platform on April 2, 2026, fans should keep a lookout for any renewal announcements to drop in May 2026. “I know that all of our fans would love to see that,” showrunner Valentina Garza told Deadline about a Season 4 pick-up. “We’re just gonna have to wait and see what happens. We’re very excited to continue to see our characters learn and grow. Sang Heon Lee as Min Ho Moon, Anna Cathcart as Kitty Song Covey in season three of XO, Kitty.Youngsol Park/Netflix When is the XO, Kitty Season 4 release date? Again, Netflix has not yet formally greenlit a fourth season of XO, Kitty; however, if the streamer continues with the series, fans can likely expect to see new episodes as early as spring 2027. For reference, season three began production in May 2025 in Seoul, South Korea, and wrapped filming in July of last year, a mere nine months before the eps premiered on Netflix. Here’s hoping they’re able to replicate that same speediness this time around! Related: Looking to Broaden Your Bingeing? Try One of the 30 Best Korean Dramas Lana Condor as Lara Jean Covey in season three of XO, KittyNetflix Who is in the XO, Kitty Season 4 cast? Well, there’s no XO, Kitty without Anna Cathcart as our leading lady Katherine “Kitty” Song Covey. We would also be shocked if we didn’t see the returns of fellow series regulars Yuri Han (Gia Kim), Min Ho Moon (Sang Heon Lee), Dae Kim (Choi Min-yeong), Q Shabazian (Anthony Keyvan), Juliana Porter (Regan Aliyah) and Marius (Sule Thelwell), as well as recurring actors like Joshua Lee (as Jin), Sasha Bhasin (as Praveena), Jocelyn Shelfo (as Madison), Han Bi Ryu (as Eunice), and Sunny Oh (as Mihee). It’s also up in the air which members of the larger To All the Boys universe, if any, would be making their return for a fourth installment. Season three saw the long-awaited appearance of Lana Candor as Kitty’s beloved older sis Lara Jean, and fellow film alums like Noah Centineo and Janel Parrish have popped up in previous seasons. Related: How to Read ‘The Summer I Turned Pretty’ Author Jenny Han’s Books in Order The season three cast of XO, KittyNetflix What will XO, Kitty Season 4 be about? Well, we know one thing: It better touch on Kitty and Min Ho’s relationship! As mentioned, a fourth season would likely take Kitty through her final semester at KISS and into graduation, which means the future — including enrollment at New York University for college in the fall — is very much looming ahead for our Covey girl. How will her planned return to America affect their connection? At least showrunner Valentina Garza is aware that fans want to see more from the will-they-won’t-they couple. “Well, I know that the audience wants to see that, and I’m so grateful that our audience is really invested in these characters that are so incredibly rich,” she told Swooon. “And I think we’re just going to have to wait and see what happens with them.” Is there a trailer for XO, Kitty season 4? Not yet, but Parade will update you the second any new trailers and teaser clips drop!
